headline.en: Net inflation persists at +2.00%/yr despite $120M protocol revenue; buyback burns only 11% of annual emissions at $9.11 price.
headline.zh: 净通胀率维持年化+2.00%，尽管协议收入达$120M，当前价格下回购销毁仅能抵消11%的年度增发

keyChanges.en: Price down 6.27% over 7 days to $9.11, despite +0.47% 24h bounce, trading 53% above DAO's $5.96 treasury burn anchor
keyChanges.zh: 价格7天下跌6.27%至$9.11，尽管24小时小幅反弹+0.47%，较DAO国库回购锚定价$5.96溢价53%

keyChanges.en: Net emission gap widened to 17.76M UNI/year: 20M emitted vs only 2.24M burned, creating +2.00% annual supply inflation
keyChanges.zh: 净增发缺口扩大至年化1776万枚UNI：增发2000万枚，销毁仅224万枚，形成年化+2.00%供应通胀

keyChanges.en: Protocol revenue annualizes to $120.22M with $20.44M buyback budget (17% of fees), but covers only 11.2% of emissions at current price
keyChanges.zh: 协议收入年化达$120.22M，回购预算$20.44M（费用的17%），但当前价格下仅能覆盖11.2%的增发量

contrarianObservation.en: $120M annualized protocol revenue is actually strong. If UNI corrects 30% to $6-7 (near treasury burn anchor), the same $20.44M buyback would burn 3-3.4M UNI, materially narrowing the inflation gap and potentially flipping to net deflationary—creating a natural price floor. The market may be overshooting down precisely to force this equilibrium.
contrarianObservation.zh: 年化$120M的协议收入其实很强。如果UNI回调30%至$6-7区间（接近国库回购锚定价），相同的$20.44M回购预算将销毁3-3.4M枚代币，大幅缩小通胀缺口甚至转为净通缩——形成天然价格底部。市场可能正通过超跌倒逼这一平衡点出现。

watchNext.en: BTC dominance at 58.74%—if it breaks down, alt season could override fundamental concerns and trigger reflexive rally
watchNext.zh: BTC主导率58.74%——若回落可能引发山寨季行情，覆盖基本面问题并触发反身性上涨

fullReasoning.en: UNI trades at $9.11, a 53% premium to the $5.96 treasury burn price—the DAO's own fair value mark from the 100M UNI buyback. The core problem: despite fee switch narrative, UNI remains net inflationary at +2.00%/year. With 20M UNI annual emissions and only 2.24M burned at current prices (17% of $120M annualized revenue), there's a 17.76M UNI net supply increase. This structural deficit explains why UNI dropped 6.27% over 7 days even as protocol revenue stays strong. The market is pricing that fee switch alone doesn't solve inflation—it just reduces it. Without real-yield pivot moving through governance (forum shows no momentum), UNI is stuck in reflexive doom loop: higher price → weaker burn rate → more net inflation → price pressure. In high BTC dominance environment (58.74%), structurally challenged alts get hit first. Derivatives market calm (funding +0.01%, OI $51M) suggests no imminent squeeze, but long/short ratio 1.58 shows retail positioned for upside fundamentals don't support. Bearish until price corrects toward $6-7 (where burn math improves) or governance catalyzes real-yield transition.
fullReasoning.zh: UNI当前价格$9.11，较国库回购锚定价$5.96溢价53%——这是DAO通过1亿枚UNI回购标定的公允价值。核心问题：尽管费用开关叙事火热，UNI仍处于年化+2.00%的净通胀状态。年度增发2000万枚，按当前价格仅能销毁224万枚（17%协议收入的$120M年化值），净增供应1776万枚。这一结构性赤字解释了为何UNI七天跌6.27%，即便协议收入强劲。市场定价逻辑：单靠费用开关无法解决通胀，只是缓解。真实收益转型提案未在治理中推进（论坛无动能），UNI陷入反身性困局：价格越高→销毁率越弱→净通胀越重→价格承压。在BTC主导率58.74%的环境下，结构性问题代币首当其冲。衍生品市场平静（资金费率+0.01%，持仓量$51M），无明显挤压信号，但多空比1.58显示散户做多，基本面不支持。看空立场，直至价格回调至$6-7（销毁数学改善区间）或治理催化真实收益转型。
